slides.title: LEFTNet: Encoding Frame Transitions
text: Motivation: how to properly evaluate expressive power of geometric GNNs,
in terms of discriminating 3D graph isomorphism?
• local substructure encoding is an edge-wise scalarization module
to encode triangles containing the edge.
• frame transition encoding is an aggregates information over multiple frames
while considering difference (transition) of multiple frames.

slides.title: AlphaNet: Scaling Local Frame-based Methods
text: • Local frame-based methods were popularized by their simplicity in design.
• Later superceded by methods based on more general “steerable” methods
(using spherical harmonics and Clebsch-Gordan tensor products).
However, local frame-based methods are not necessarily
worse than the more complex methods!
• Rotary positional embedding to encode frame transitions.
• Use temporal connections to model long-range interactions.

slides.title: AlphaNet: Scaling Local Frame-based Methods
text: In large scale, AlphaNet achieves the best performance-inference tradeoff (25.01).
